requirements.statement: Users can sign in to access the app

criteria.must: An unauthenticated user is redirected to sign in when opening the app
A user who completes sign-in is returned to the app

requirements.statement: Signed-in users see a fixed "Hello, World!" greeting on the page

criteria.must: The page displays the exact text "Hello, World!" after sign-in
The greeting is identical for every signed-in user, with no personalization or input fields
